new_learnings.text: Both positions (科陆电子 -15.6%, 明阳智能 -21.0%) blew through -5% hard stops without being exited. The daily LLM review process is too slow to enforce intraday stop losses. MUST implement automated stop-loss execution independent of daily analysis cycle. The -5% rule cannot depend on a once-daily review.
new_learnings.related_hypothesis: h018 (breakout failure is accelerated exit signal)
new_learnings.mechanism: Daily review cadence means a stock can gap through a stop and the system only notices the next day. By then, the loss has compounded. Automated intraday monitoring is the only reliable enforcement.

new_learnings.text: 明阳智能 entry was fundamentally flawed: 6.4% gross margin, -222% operating income quality, 99.9% subsidiary leverage. Even in a momentum system, there is a quality floor. A company that can barely generate operating profit should not be bought regardless of sector momentum. New filter: gross_margin < 10% = automatic skip for non-commodity stocks.
new_learnings.mechanism: Ultra-low gross margins mean the company has no pricing power and minimal buffer against cost increases. When sector momentum fades, these stocks fall hardest because there's no earnings floor to support the price.

new_learnings.text: Market regime shifted to geopolitical-driven energy rotation (美伊冲突). When geopolitical events dominate, only directly-affected sectors (oil/gas/energy/defense) hold up. Grid equipment and wind power, despite being 'energy adjacent', get sold along with everything else. Sector adjacency ≠ sector alignment.
new_learnings.mechanism: In geopolitical risk-off events, money flows to direct beneficiaries (oil producers, defense) and out of everything else including 'related' sectors. The correlation between 电网设备 and 油气开采 is low during crisis periods.

new_learnings.text: Portfolio is now -4.74% total return with 95% cash. The two open positions account for nearly all losses. Lesson: position sizing was correct (3% each) but stop enforcement was catastrophically wrong. If stops had been honored at -5%, total loss from these two positions would have been ~0.3% of portfolio instead of ~1.5%+.
new_learnings.mechanism: Small position sizes protect against individual stock risk, but only if stops are enforced. A 3% position with a -5% stop = 0.15% portfolio loss. A 3% position with a -20% actual loss = 0.6% portfolio loss — 4x worse.

new_learnings.text: 13 of 23 strategy pool stocks have RPS120 > 95% (above the chasing cutoff). This suggests the pool is heavily skewed toward extended stocks. When the market corrects, these are the stocks that fall hardest. The strategy pool selection criteria may need recalibration to include more stocks in the 80-92% sweet spot.
new_learnings.mechanism: RPS120 > 95% stocks have already had their big run. In a correction, they have the most profit-taking pressure and the furthest to fall to mean-revert.
